name: Proving Grounds 28: The Sundered Ward. The final battle, another way: a marble terrace climbing high over Hollowmark at twilight, from the plaza (0) to the summoning dais (10). Tiers meet at two-level cliffs, so the stairs are the chokepoints: the west galleries and balcony (2, 4, 6), the processional between the pools (0, 2, 4) overlooked from both sides, the east terraces a level at a time (1 to 4) and a perch (6). A glowing spirit ward (9) is torn open in three breaches whose stairs climb through it onto the sanctum ring (8).
